title: Soft ride and soft steering feel
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on a soft, smooth ride and a softer steering feel, with most examples not clearly indicating whether that characteristic is favorable or unfavorable.

positive.summary: Positive feedback highlights enjoying the vehicle's soft ride quality.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined feedback describes soft steering and a smooth or soft ride without enough context to classify those traits as praise or criticism consistently.

limitations: Most examples are undetermined, so the balance between favorable and unfavorable views on soft steering or ride cannot be established from these samples alone.
The topic combines ride comfort and steering feel, which are related but distinct aspects.
